summary: Frontend-only verification of the new POS void-confirmation dialog (Pos.jsx). Logged in via PIN 2222 (Кассир Мария), opened shift, and ran 5 UI scenarios on the public preview URL. All 4 requested scenarios plus 1 extra (partial void of a multi-item printed order) PASSED. No console errors, no error elements on page, no leftover open orders (all 8 tables show 'Свободен' after cleanup).

issues: Sonner toast ('Заказ отправлен на кухню' / 'СТОРНО отправлено на цех') renders bottom-right and overlaps the primary 'Оплатить' button — cosmetic, does not block clicks after toast dismissal but can hide the CTA for ~4s.

critical_code_review_comments: Pos.jsx requestVoid(): for a non-printed (pending) line it calls store.removeItem(index) only — local state. If the order already exists in DB (e.g. it was persisted earlier by 'Счёт'/'Перенос' which call saveOrder), the pending line remains in Mongo until the next saveOrder/send/pay. Consider calling the DELETE /orders/{id}/items/{idx} endpoint when store.orderId exists, even for pending items, to keep client and server in sync.

Kitchen tickets modal: the X (tickets-close-btn) both closes the modal AND navigates back to the tables screen, while clicking the overlay only closes the modal. Inconsistent close behaviour — minor UX.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Temporary orders on Стол 1 and Стол 2 were created and fully voided/cancelled during testing. NOTE: a cashier shift was opened by the test (open-shift-btn) and is still OPEN — no open orders remain, so shift close is clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Void confirmation flow verified end-to-end: pending void = instant (no dialog); printed void = dialog 'Сторнировать позицию?' with void-cancel-btn/void-confirm-btn; cancel keeps item with 'отправлено' badge; confirm voids (toast 'СТОРНО отправлено на цех' when other items remain, 'Заказ отменён' + return to 'Выберите стол' when it was the last item). Test flow tips: after send-kitchen-btn a tickets modal appears — close it by clicking the overlay (page.mouse.click(30,30)), NOT tickets-close-btn (that navigates back to tables).
